Before you begin

A good setup starts here.

Lay out the parts on a protected, flat surface. Wear protective gloves and check the supplied parts before you start.

  • Find the five castors, wheelbase and gas lift with its cover.
  • Check the backrest, seatbase, armrests and multi-tilt mechanism.
  • Keep the legrest, pillows, side covers and Allen key nearby.

Many screws are pre-attached. Side-cover screws and any extras are packed separately.

Anatomy direction

Five castors, gas lift, multi-tilt mechanism, seat, backrest, armrests and pull-out legrest. The active assembly will separate and seat along its fitting direction. Four-tone solid geometry, precise seams and hardware, calm motion, keyboard controls and reduced motion support.
